ignore.reason: The fixture bold images (roast_utils.nii_bytes, written by the tests) have the nibabel default TR of 1 s in their header; the site templates carry the real TR. The ABIDE-I XNAT fixture sets the header TR, and SALD's images agree with its template: neither is ignored.
The SliceTiming of the site templates (bold, but also some T2w and dwi templates) has one entry per real slice; the fixture images have 2 slices.

The fixture images are gzipped by the tests with gzip.compress, which records a modification time; these roasters copy the images byte for byte. Images the roasters write (OASIS-I/II, Bullitt, UNC-Wisconsin) and SALD's (gzipped with mtime=0) are not ignored.
